episode.genre_reason: A story about a town committed to truth explains deaths after a false answer.
episode.form: Reported first-person story, alternate narrator names, and dialogue
notes: Rava quotes the sage; the story then shifts from first-person to third-person wording. Shared claims use unknown for the teller whose name depends on the report. The two sons are separated only for their family paths. A request to leave is not a reported departure.
